body.prompt: A military vehicle explosion seen from the side: a big bold fireball burst on the ground with flying dark debris chunks and dust, billowing into a thick rolling smoke cloud. Bold simple silhouette, high contrast, chunky shapes, few large shapes rather than fine detail, isolated on a plain white background

assets.prompt: A side-view military vehicle caught at the center of a compact explosion, its low armored silhouette partly obscured by a broad orange-and-yellow fireball erupting along the ground. Large dark fragments arc outward around the blast, with a few chunky dust shapes at ground level. A thick, rolling charcoal smoke cloud rises above the flames in overlapping lobes. Use flat cel-shaded color blocks, hard-edged two-tone shading, and bold even outlines; keep the entire silhouette centered with clear space around it on a plain light-gray background.

assets.prompt: A wide, ground-hugging fireball bursts around a military vehicle seen directly from the side. The vehicle’s angular body remains partly readable beneath the flames, while several large dark debris chunks lift above and beside the blast. Dust spreads in a short, uneven band near the ground, and dense smoke billows upward in connected rounded masses. Render the fire with distinct yellow, orange, and deep-red areas, using chunky shapes, hard-edged cel shading, and bold outlines. Keep the isolated effect centered on a plain light-gray background.
